AC-1.statement: In the Share dialog, picking 7 days and creating the link shows a link whose stored expiry is 168 hours after the click, to the minute.
POST /api/links with an expiresAt 7 days ahead answers 200, and the body returns expiresAt unchanged.

AC-2.statement: GET /s/:token for a link that expired 1 second ago answers 410, and the body holds 0 characters of the note.
Opening that link in a browser shows the words 'This link has expired' and no note title.

AC-3.statement: GET /s/:token for a link with no expiry answers 200 with the note, after the server clock moves 365 days.

AC-4.statement: POST /api/links with an expiresAt 1 second in the past answers 400, and the link count stays the same.
tests/expiry.test.ts 'refuses an expiry time that is not in the future' passes at the head.

AC-5.statement: GET /s/:token for a link that is both revoked and expired answers 404 or 410, and the body holds 0 characters of the note.

AC-6.statement: A digest built for a team with 2 links expiring within 7 days and 1 expiring in 8 days lists exactly 2 links.

AC-7.statement: After migration 006 on a database with 2 existing links, 0 rows have a non-null expires_at.
GET /s/:token for each of those 2 links answers 200 with the note.

AC-8.statement: DELETE /api/links/:id then GET /s/:token gives the same status and a body of the same length at the base and at the head, for 1 revoked link.

AC-9.statement: A digest built for a week with no changed note and no link expiring within 7 days sends 0 mails, at the base and at the head.

AC-10.statement: POST /api/links as a viewer answers 403 at the base and at the head.

AC-11.statement: GET /api/export for a team with 1 note whose link expires tomorrow returns a body that is byte-for-byte equal at the base and at the head.
